task.ques: On Apple's website, check the estimated battery life of the latest MacBook Air during web browsing in Tech Specs.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: The latest MacBook Air with M5 (13-inch and 15-inch) is rated for up to 15 hours of wireless web browsing. Apple’s Tech Specs → Battery and Power states “Up to 15 hours wireless web” for both sizes. Source: https://www.apple.com/macbook-air/specs/ (checked October 27, 2026). Evidence: final.png.
